snippet.title: KILLER INN | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A corpse has been found... and everyone is a suspect.
You have been chosen to participate in a one-night-only game of death, deceit, and deduction. Will you be a wolf? Or perhaps a lamb with the means to fight back...
In deception we trust.

🐺🔪🐑

Applications for the Closed Beta Test (Steam® Playtest) on Steam® are now open.
Apply and add to Wishlist here: https://sqex.to/KI_STM_OTH_WE

More details, including the timing of the Steam® Playtest, will be shared soon on the Steam® News Hub and the official Square Enix and KILLER INN social media channels.
Steam® News Hub: https://sqex.to/KI_STM_NEWS
Official X (previously Twitter): https://x.com/PlayKillerInn
Official Discord: https://sqex.to/KI_DISCORD
Official Website: https://www.square-enix.com/killer-inn/
